schemaVersion.description: MCP I/O schema version of this output.

message.description: Human-readable, actionable message. Never contains a secret.

source.description: The typed error class this was mapped from (RecorderError, InstallError, SynthError, …).

section.description: DECODE_FAILED only: the XDR section that failed.

details.description: Structured details when the source carried them (InstallError details; the server’s own semantic checks). Absent for RecorderError, whose message is self-contained.

description: Tool execution error envelope (the result has isError: true).
